skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract numerators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that share the same denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Separate whole and fraction parts of mixed numbers and subtract the integer parts.

skills.name: Borrow and adjust fraction
skills.definition: When fraction subtraction yields a negative result, borrow 1 from the whole part and add the denominator to the fraction before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.
